approach: Static recompilation of the whole Xbox 360 executable (XenonRecomp) plus a runtime for the native port, a matching decompilation of n-Space's own C++ with the original compiler, and the game's UnrealScript decompiled from its cooked packages.
notes: An independent, non-commercial preservation project for the cancelled Halo Mega Bloks game (Project Haggar, n-Space, Unreal Engine 3), not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, 343 Industries, n-Space, Mega Brands or Epic Games. Source only: the repository contains no game files and no SDK files. Progress is tracked in docs/PROGRESS.md. New contributors: start with docs/START_HERE.md, and claim work in issue #1 before you begin.
